scope: Debugger configuration and diagnostic capture commands using unchanged existing application firmware; no write workaround or controller implementation added.

known_evidence.summary: D0ACK and6BACK observed with no complete wake-value byte; precise failed HAL wait is not recorded.

static_checks.name: Firmware and application preservation
static_checks.evidence: All three image hashes match Stage 2/3; no Core, Drivers or Makefile changes.

static_checks.name: Breakpoint location and current-error source
static_checks.evidence: ELF retains EndHardwareTrace at0x08002b34; Sensor_Write stores HAL return before calling it and reaches fallback afterwards. sensor_i2c->ErrorCode is read instead of stale haptic_app_status.i2c_error.

static_checks.name: Required debug symbols
static_checks.evidence: EndHardwareTrace, hw_trace_flag/isr/cr2, haptic_app_status and sensor_i2c retain debug symbols.

static_checks.name: Offline GDB command definitions and expressions
static_checks.evidence: GDB16.3 accepted breakpoint/actions and type-checked 18 printed field expressions; exit0/no stderr. Remote and continue disabled in temporary validation copy; actions not executed.

static_checks.name: Wokwi and VS Code configuration syntax
static_checks.evidence: TOML/JSON parse; debugger port3333; process task has explicit ELF/script and GDB executable prompt. Live connection not tested.

static_checks.name: Capture provenance and file separation
static_checks.evidence: Offline transcript clearly labelled; no stage-4-write.txt fabricated in repository. User capture and optional VCD have separate ignored paths.

runtime_checks.name: User GDB executable and Wokwi connection
runtime_checks.note: User confirms toolchain installed; actual GDB path/version and live connection await user run.

runtime_checks.name: Capture first wake-write result before fallback
runtime_checks.note: No target values captured by offline validation.

runtime_checks.name: Confirm exact failed wait phase
runtime_checks.note: TCR versus following TXIS remains unconfirmed.

runtime_checks.name: Successful wake and range configuration
runtime_checks.note: Prior user evidence shows wake write fails; no fix applied.

runtime_checks.name: Real acceleration reads respond to changed inputs
runtime_checks.note: Requires successful initialization; identity read alone is insufficient.

limitations: No live Wokwi debugger connection tested by agent.
Offline command definitions and field types were checked; target values/actions were not executed.
Current firmware still has the observed sensor wake failure.
Exact servo calibration and movement/direction checks remain open.
